cohort: The study population consisted of 18,056,390 hospital deliveries in the United States from 2016 to 2020.
finding: Pregnant patients with a diagnosis of OSA represent a high-risk group associated with significantly increased odds of adverse obstetric outcomes, respiratory and cardiac morbidities, and severe maternal morbidity at delivery.
mod_finding: Pregnancy with OSA was associated with an increased likelihood of cesarean delivery (aOR 1.42, 95%CI 1.37-1.48).
